falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern formed after a significant decline and required lower prices to resolve; this would prove the current signal is not a bottom but something else entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on stability, directly contradicting a bottom formation which requires elevated or spiking fear; this would prove the market is in a calm continuation phase rather than a capitulation/reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 5+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained flight-to-quality bid in bonds with yields collapsing would signal recession panic or deflationary shock, invalidating the bottom pattern which typically resolves with yields stable-to-rising as growth expectations recover; this would prove the macro regime is breakdown rather than bottoming

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
